answer.rationale: Finance mandates an 18% cost reduction that the incumbent refuses to match. The low-cost vendor’s quote meets this mandate. Historical evidence (memory_c2) shows this vendor enabled sharp cost cuts with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing, implying low delivery risk. With the primary contract expiring in 14 days and production at 94% capacity with no buffer, a broad rollout to the low-cost vendor is the only action that achieves the cost mandate without increasing delivery risk. Alternative risk mitigation via second sourcing (memory_c3) is not actionable as a single decision within the timeframe.
